blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A trader writes many short reports. She likes to look back at the week. "Looking back is also progress," she says.

Yesterday, she wrote the report. She sent the invoice. She called the client. These are small things, but they are important.

Today she learns five verbs: write, wrote, send, sent, and yesterday. It is her first look at the Past Simple. "Look back, move forward," she thinks.

items.q: What does the trader write?
items.why: "A trader writes many short reports." — muitos relatórios curtos.

items.q: What did she do yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday, she wrote the report."

items.q: What is she learning today?
options: Her first look at the Past Simple
items.why: "It is her first look at the Past Simple."

items.q: The text suggests that the trader thinks small tasks are…
items.why: Inferência: "These are small things, but they are important."

items.q: "Look back, move forward" suggests that looking at the past…
items.why: Inferência: "Looking back is also progress" — olhar para trás ajuda a avançar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça o trader no fechamento de sexta-feira. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Ethan. It is Friday, so let me tell you about my week.

On Monday, I wrote the weekly report. It was short, but clear. On Tuesday, I sent five invoices to our clients. I also called two clients in the morning.

On Wednesday, the ship arrived. Sophie and I checked the market at eight in the morning. It was a busy day, but a good one.

Yesterday, I wrote ten emails. I know, it is a lot! And this morning, I sent the payment on time. Sophie met the new team on Monday too.

So, that is my week. I wrote reports, I sent invoices, and I called clients. Small things, but I did them all. Have a good weekend, Ethan!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What day is it when the trader speaks?
items.why: "It is Friday, so let me tell you about my week."

items.q: How many invoices did the trader send on Tuesday?
items.why: "On Tuesday, I sent five invoices to our clients."

items.q: What did the trader write yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday, I wrote ten emails."

items.q: The trader says her week was busy. This suggests she…
items.why: Inferência: "It was a busy day" e a lista de tarefas mostram muito trabalho.

items.q: How does the trader feel about her week?
items.why: Inferência: "a good one", "but I did them all" — tom positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I wrote the report yesterday." Wrote is the past of…
items.why: Wrote = passado de write (escrever).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Yesterday, I ___ the report to my boss."
items.why: "Yesterday" pede passado: sent.

items.q: "She will send the invoice today." Send means…
options: to enviar / to make it go to someone
items.why: Send = enviar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ ten emails this morning."
items.why: "This morning" (já passou) pede o passado: wrote.

items.q: "The ship arrived yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I sent the payment on time." This means the payment was…
options: at the right time, not late
items.why: On time = na hora certa, sem atraso.

items.q: "Let me tell you about my week" — the speaker wants to…
options: say what happened in the week
items.why: "Tell you about my week" = contar o que aconteceu na semana.

items.q: "Look back, move forward." To look back means to…
items.why: Look back = olhar para trás, pensar no que passou.

items.q: "That is a lot of emails!" A lot means…
items.why: A lot = muito, um número grande.

items.q: "Have a good weekend!" The weekend is…
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).
